$comment: VAT ID examples for the format rule DQ-10 (AC-03): one passing and one failing example per country of the world, plus Greece as a test case only. The formats and their sources are in DATA_SOURCES.md. Every example is made up for the test; the rule checks prefix and format, never a check digit.

countries.why: eight digits instead of nine or twelve
eight digits and no B suffix
the U after AT is missing
first and last characters both digits, which VIES rules out (correction B1)
Greece's VAT prefix is EL, not its country code GR

more.why: a government department, GD and three digits
a health authority, HA and three digits
the printed form with separators and the German suffix
the printed form with the French suffix
the printed form with spaces and the Italian suffix
a digit first and a letter last
a key of a digit and a letter
lower case and spaces are normalised
an Austrian number on a German supplier: the prefix differs
an empty VAT ID counts as missing
